column1: # Every episode slug published at https://cortech.online/podcast/rss.xml, paired
# with its episode date. Captured 2026-08-23 from the live feed's <guid isPermaLink>
# values (`podcast/<slug>/`) and <pubDate>; all 75 were minted by the old
# title-derived slugify() from date-only titles ("Daily Digest - August 23, 2026").
# cortech.online publishes each of these as an isPermaLink guid, and Spotify treats a
# changed guid as a brand-new episode. So this file is a compatibility contract, not a
# sample: slug_for_date() must reproduce every line byte-for-byte, forever (#128).
# Append new dates; never edit or delete an existing line.
